job.rawJd:
General recruiter and networking profile, not an employer posting.

Target: Marketing Manager, Brand Strategist, Integrated Marketing Lead, Marketing Strategy Lead, and adjacent client-facing marketing roles.

Core work: understand audience and business needs; shape brand and campaign strategy; translate strategy into briefs and creative direction; coordinate cross-functional delivery across channels; use research and performance signals to improve the work; and help teams apply AI in practical marketing workflows.

Resume architecture: lead with recent marketing innovation across AI tools, digital products, enterprise analytics, and customer experience. Use the earlier brand, campaign, and account work as direct proof of integrated marketing, audience strategy, budgets, creative development, and regulated delivery. Keep UX and product experience as evidence of customer insight and digital execution.

This package must be fit-gated again against each employer's actual job description before application.

classification.primarySource: The resume directly shows eight years managing Fortune 500 pharma marketing, brand budgets up to $20M, integrated campaigns across television and digital channels, brand planning, creative briefs, audience research, MLR review, and cross-functional delivery.
classification.supportingSource: The portfolio adds proof of marketing analytics, audience research, enterprise experience strategy, regulated content workflows, and practical AI implementation. It strengthens the modern marketing story without replacing the resume's campaign evidence.
